description: A custom package for OpenSearch Service domains, such as a dictionary file or a plugin, imported from Amazon S3 with CreatePackage. AWS keeps its own copy of the file, so a new file at the same S3 key changes nothing: point PackageSource at another key to update the package. Every update imports PackageSource again with UpdatePackage, which makes a new package version. Domains keep the version they have until the package is associated with them again. AWS can't delete a package while it is associated with a domain, so such a delete fails with 409 Conflict: give each AWS::OpenSearchService::PackageAssociation of the package dependsOn on it, such as by referencing its PackageID.

PackageSource.description: The Amazon S3 object to import the package from.

S3BucketName.description: The name of the S3 bucket that holds the package.

S3Key.description: The key of the package's S3 object.

PackageConfiguration.description: The configuration and license requirements of a plugin package. AWS returns them only as the package's available configuration, so they are write-only, and create-only, because AWS doesn't say what an update that leaves them out does.

ConfigurationRequirement.description: Whether the plugin needs a configuration package.

LicenseRequirement.description: Whether the plugin needs a license package.

LicenseFilepath.description: The relative path of the plugin's license file, without '..'.

RequiresRestartForConfigurationUpdate.description: Whether a change of the plugin's configuration needs a blue/green deployment of the domain.

PackageEncryptionOptions.description: How AWS encrypts the package. AWS doesn't say how to remove these options, so a deploy that removes them fails with 400 Bad Request: set EncryptionEnabled to false instead.

EncryptionEnabled.description: Whether the package is encrypted with KmsKeyIdentifier.

KmsKeyIdentifier.description: The KMS key that encrypts the package.

PackageVendingOptions.description: Whether other accounts can use the package.

VendingEnabled.description: Whether the package can be shared with other accounts.

PackageName.description: The name of the package, unique in the account and Region.

EngineVersion.description: The engine version the plugin works with, such as OpenSearch_2.15. Only for a ZIP-PLUGIN package.

PackageID.description: The ID AWS assigns the package, which a PackageAssociation takes.

AvailablePackageVersion.description: The latest version of the package.
